The '''Migrant Merchants' Guild Computer Lab''' was a computer lab in the [[Old Galactic Market]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Kixiaralu]] was forced to work for the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]].
